mechanism: 8-bit weights (FP8 or INT8 per-channel with dynamic activations) stay within answer-level noise; 4-bit GPTQ costs ~2% on knowledge-heavy multiple choice.
summary: BlameGraph correctness gate, full tier (18,606 items: MMLU-Pro 12,032, MATH 5,000, MBPP 974, needle 600), pooled task score vs the BF16 batch-invariant vLLM reference, thinking off, 2026-10-05. Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-FP8: 1.0009 with VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0, 1.0034 with DeepGEMM on (KL mean 3.4e-3 / 4.9e-3). nytopop/Qwen3-30B-A3B.w8a8 (compressed-tensors INT8 W8A8, experts quantized): loads in 15 s, 0.9993, KL 5.1e-3. Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GPTQ-Int4: 0.9869, fails the 99% rule; loss is in MMLU-Pro (0.9807, McNemar p 3e-5), MATH/MBPP/needle alone would pass; KL 1.7e-2. JunHowie/Qwen3-30B-A3B-GPTQ-Int8 cannot load on vLLM 0.30 (act-order GPTQ MoE experts: no parameter 'w2_g_idx'). FP8 and INT8 each lose and gain ~800 answers in balance.
title: Qwen3-30B-A3B quantized checkpoints on vLLM 0.30, H200: FP8 and INT8 W8A8 keep >=99% accuracy, GPTQ-Int4 does not; GPTQ-Int8 does not load
triggers: before shipping a quantized Qwen3-30B-A3B path
a vLLM upgrade (GPTQ-Int8 MoE support may change)
